title: 6 Decisions That Make All the Difference for a Successful Retirement | Dimensional
gist: Promotional landing page for Episode 65 of Dimensional's The Informed Investor podcast, in which Mark Gochnour discusses the retirement decisions DIY investors must get right; the captured text holds only two generic takeaways (learn finance early, plan comprehensively), so the card is deliberately thin.

insights.claim: Dimensional's Mark Gochnour advises DIY investors to learn as much about finance and investing as possible at an early age as a foundation for a successful retirement.
insights.speaker: Mark Gochnour
insights.so_what: Low direct signal; reflects Dimensional's client-education push toward self-directed retirement savers.

insights.claim: Dimensional's Mark Gochnour argues retirement should be planned comprehensively (spanning equity, fixed income and tax decisions) rather than as isolated choices.
insights.speaker: Mark Gochnour
insights.so_what: Holistic planning framing (investments plus tax) is the standard advisor pitch; no actionable market view.
insights.quote: Try to plan for retirement in a comprehensive way.

insights.claim: Dimensional frames retirement success for DIY investors around a small set of six critical decisions, discussed in Episode 65 of its The Informed Investor podcast; the specific six decisions are not listed in the page text.
insights.speaker: Mark Gochnour
insights.so_what: Listen to the episode itself if the decision list matters; the page text alone gives no specifics.
insights.locator: In Episode 65 of The Informed Investor podcast

source_meta.author: Featuring Mark Gochnour, Head of Global Client Services Group
